answer: Because the saffron index resolves every citation against the glacier checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the ferrous audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 263 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 263 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 3841 identities would post 1642 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
